entries.Acorn_Description: This can be planted to grow an oak tree.
entries.AdvancedTVRemote_Description: It has more buttons than a regular remote. Perfect for the avid TV watcher!
entries.AgedRoe_Description: Fish eggs aged in salt to bring out the flavor.
entries.Alamite_Description: Its distinctive fluorescence makes it a favorite among rock collectors.
entries.Albacore_Description: Prefers temperature "edges" where cool and warm water meet.
entries.AmaranthSeeds_Description: Plant these in the fall. Takes 7 days to grow. Harvest with the scythe.
entries.Amaranth_Description: A purple grain cultivated by an ancient civilization.
entries.AmphibianFossil_Description: The relatively short hind legs suggest some kind of primordial toad.
entries.Anchor_Description: It may have belonged to ancient pirates.
entries.Anchovy_Description: A small silver fish found in the ocean.
entries.AncientDoll_Description: An ancient doll covered in grime. This doll may have been used as a toy, a decoration, or a prop in some kind of ritual.
entries.AncientDrum_Description: It's a drum made from wood and animal skin. It has a low, reverberating tone.
entries.AncientFruitPot: Her roots grow very deep... she wouldn't be happy in there.
entries.AncientSeed_Description: It's a dry old seed from some ancient plant. By all appearances it's long since dead...
entries.AncientSword_Description: It's the remains of an ancient sword. Most of the blade has turned to rust, but the hilt is very finely crafted.
entries.Angler_Description: Uses a bioluminescent dangler to attract prey.
entries.AppleSapling_Description: Takes 28 days to produce a mature Apple tree. Bears fruit in the fall. Only grows if the 8 surrounding "tiles" are empty.
entries.Apple_Description: A crisp fruit used for juice and cider.
entries.ApricotSapling_Description: Takes 28 days to produce a mature Apricot tree. Bears fruit in the spring. Only grows if the 8 surrounding "tiles" are empty.
entries.Apricot_Description: A tender little fruit with a rock-hard pit.
entries.ArcticShard_Description: This shard glows with an otherworldly blue light.
entries.Arrowhead_Description: A crudely fashioned point used for hunting.
entries.ArtichokeSeeds_Description: Plant these in the fall. Takes 8 days to mature.
entries.Artichoke_Description: The bud of a thistle plant. The spiny outer leaves conceal a fleshy, filling interior.
entries.ArtifactSpot_Description: How did you get this in your inventory?
entries.ArtifactTrove_Description: A blacksmith can open this for you. These troves often contain ancient relics and curiosities.
entries.Bait_Description: Causes fish to bite faster. Must first be attached to a fishing rod.
entries.BakedFish_Description: Baked fish on a bed of herbs.
entries.BananaPudding_Description: A creamy dessert with a wonderful tropical flavor.
entries.BananaSapling_Description: Takes 28 days to produce a mature Banana tree. Bears fruit in the summer, or all year round when planted on Ginger Island.
entries.BarbedHook_Description: Makes your catch more secure, causing the "fishing bar" to cling to your catch. Works best on slow, weak fish.
entries.Baryte_Description: The best specimens resemble a desert rose.
entries.BasicFertilizer_Description: Improves soil quality a little, increasing your chance to grow quality crops. Mix into tilled soil.
entries.BasicRetainingSoil_Description: This soil has a chance of staying watered overnight. Mix into tilled soil.
entries.BatteryPack_Description: It's fully charged with precious energy.
entries.BeanStarter_Description: Plant these in the spring. Takes 10 days to mature, but keeps producing after that. Grows on a trellis.
entries.BeetSeeds_Description: Plant these in the fall. Takes 6 days to mature.
entries.Beet_Description: A sweet and earthy root vegetable. As a bonus, the leaves make a great salad.
entries.BerryBasket_Description: The fibers are stained with berry juice.
entries.Bixite_Description: A dark metallic Mineral sought after for its cubic structure.
entries.Blobfish_Description: This odd creature floats above the ocean floor, consuming any edible material in its path.
entries.BlueDiscus_Description: A brightly colored tropical fish that is popular in aquariums.
entries.BlueGrassStarter_Description: Place this on your farm to plant a clump of blue grass.
entries.BlueJazz_Description: The flower grows in a sphere to invite as many butterflies as possible.
entries.BlueSlimeEgg_Description: Can be hatched in a slime incubator.
entries.BlueberrySeeds_Description: Plant these in the summer. Takes 13 days to mature, and continues to produce after first harvest.
entries.Blueberry_Description: A popular berry reported to have many health benefits. The blue skin has the highest nutrient concentration.
entries.BokChoySeeds_Description: Plant these in the fall. Takes 4 days to mature.
entries.BokChoy_Description: The leafy greens and fibrous stalks are healthy and delicious.
entries.BoneFlute_Description: It's a prehistoric wind instrument carved from an animal's bone. It produces an eerie tone.
entries.Book_AnimalCatalogue_Description: You can access Marnie's shop when she's not around.
entries.Book_Artifact_Description: You will fetch a better price when selling artifacts.
entries.Book_Bombs_Description: Bombs deal 25% less damage to you.
entries.Book_Crabbing_Description: Crab pots have a 25% chance to yield double.
entries.Book_Defense_Name: Jack Be Nimble, Jack Be Thick
entries.Book_Diamonds_Description: All stones have a chance to drop a diamond when mined by hand.
entries.Book_Friendship_Description: You become friends with people a little faster.
entries.Book_Marlon_Description: You get a 50% discount on Marlon's item retrieval service.
entries.Book_Mystery_Description: You have a slightly greater chance to find Mystery Boxes.
entries.Book_PriceCatalogue_Description: You can now see the value of your items.
entries.Book_QueenOfSauce_Description: Learn any Queen Of Sauce recipes that you don't already know.
entries.Book_Riding_Description: You gain a little extra speed when riding a horse.
entries.Book_Roe_Description: Fishing treasure chests have a chance to yield roe.
entries.Book_Speed2_Description: You run a little bit faster.
entries.Book_Speed_Description: You run a little bit faster.
entries.Book_Trash_Description: You have a greater chance to find items in the trash.
entries.Book_Void_Description: Monsters have a small chance to drop double loot.
entries.Book_WildSeeds_Description: Weeds have a greater chance to yield mixed seeds.
entries.Book_Woodcutting_Description: Felled trees have a 5% chance to yield double the wood.
entries.Bouquet_Description: A gift that shows your romantic interest.
entries.Bream_Description: A fairly common river fish that becomes active at night.
entries.BrickFloor_Description: Place on the ground to create paths or to decorate your floors.
entries.BroccoliSeeds_Description: Plant in the fall. Takes 8 days to mature, and continues to produce after first harvest.
entries.Broccoli_Description: The flowering head of a broccoli plant. The tiny buds give it a unique texture.
entries.BrokenCD_Description: It's a JojaNet 2.0 trial CD. They must've made a billion of these things.
entries.BrokenGlasses_Description: It looks like someone lost their glasses. They're busted.
entries.Bruschetta_Description: Roasted tomatoes on a crisp white bread.
entries.BugMeat_Description: It's a juicy wad of bug flesh.
entries.BugSteak_Description: The last resort of the hungry cave diver.
entries.Bullhead_Description: A relative of the catfish that eats a variety of foods off the lake bottom.
entries.BurglarsRing_Description: Monsters have a greater chance of dropping loot.
entries.ButterflyPowder_Description: Sprinkle on a pet to remove them from your farm. The process is irreversible.
entries.CactusFruit_Description: The sweet fruit of the prickly pear cactus.
entries.CactusSeedsOutside: Must be planted indoors or on Ginger Island.
entries.CactusSeeds_Description: Can only be grown indoors. Takes 12 days to mature, and then produces fruit every 3 days.
entries.Calcite_Description: This yellow crystal is speckled with shimmering nodules.
entries.CalicoEggStone_Description: Break apart to obtain Calico Eggs.
entries.CalicoEgg_Description: A unique egg that can be found during the Desert Festival.
entries.CampingStove_Description: This allows you to cook anywhere, and is not consumed on use.
entries.CarrotSeeds_Description: Plant in the spring. Takes 3 days to grow.
entries.Carrot_Description: A fast-growing, colorful tuber that makes for a great snack.
entries.CatalogueDescription: Provides unlimited access to all wallpapers and floors... from the convenience of your home!
entries.Catfish_Description: An uncommon fish found in streams.
entries.CauliflowerSeeds_Description: Plant these in the spring. Takes 12 days to produce a large cauliflower.
entries.Cauliflower_Description: Valuable, but slow-growing. Despite its pale color, the florets are packed with nutrients.
entries.CaveCarrot_Description: A starchy snack found in caves. It helps miners work longer.
entries.CaveJelly_Description: A rare jelly found in underground lakes.
entries.Caviar_Description: The cured roe of a sturgeon fish. Considered to be a luxurious delicacy!
entries.Celestine_Description: Some early life forms had bones made from this.
entries.ChallengeBait_Description: A "perfect" catch yields triple the fish. However, each time a fish escapes the "fishing bar", the catch is reduced.
entries.Chanterelle_Description: A tasty mushroom with a fruity smell and slightly peppery flavor.
entries.CherryBomb_Description: Generates a small explosion. Stand back!
entries.CherrySapling_Description: Takes 28 days to produce a mature Cherry tree. Bears fruit in the spring. Only grows if the 8 surrounding "tiles" are empty.
entries.Cherry_Description: It's popular, and ripens sooner than most other fruits.
entries.ChewingStick_Description: Ancient people chewed on these to keep their teeth clean.
entries.ChickenStatue_Description: It's a statue of a chicken on a bronze base. The ancient people of this area must have been very fond of chickens.
entries.ChippedAmphora_Description: An ancient vessel made of ceramic material. Used to transport both dry and wet goods.
entries.ChocolateCake_Description: Rich and moist with a thick fudge icing.
entries.Chowder_Description: A perfect way to warm yourself after a cold night at sea.
entries.Chub_Description: A common freshwater fish known for its voracious appetite.
entries.CinderShardStone_Description: Break apart to obtain cinder shards.
entries.CinderShard_Description: You can feel a warm glow from within this stone.
entries.Clam_Description: There's a chewy little guy in there...
entries.Cloth_Description: A bolt of fine wool cloth.
entries.Coal_Description: A combustible rock that is useful for crafting and smelting.
entries.CobblestonePath_Description: Place on the ground to create paths or to spruce up your floors.
entries.Coconut_Description: A seed of the coconut palm. It has many culinary uses.
entries.CoffeeBean_Description: Plant in spring or summer to grow a coffee plant. Place five beans in a keg to make coffee.
entries.Coffee_Description: It smells delicious. This is sure to give you a boost.
entries.Coleslaw_Description: It's light, fresh and very healthy.
entries.CompleteBreakfast_Description: You'll feel ready to take on the world!
entries.CookoutKit_Description: Use this to create a cooking campfire, allowing you to cook on-the-go!
entries.CopperOre_Description: A common ore that can be smelted into bars.
entries.CopperStone_Description: There's copper ore in this stone.
entries.Coral_Description: A colony of tiny creatures that clump together to form beautiful structures.
entries.CorkBobber_Description: Slightly increases the size of your "fishing bar".
entries.CornSeeds_Description: Plant these in the summer or fall. Takes 14 days to mature, and continues to produce after first harvest.
entries.Corn_Description: One of the most popular grains. The sweet, fresh cobs are a summer favorite.
entries.CrabCakes_Description: Crab, bread crumbs, and egg formed into patties then fried to a golden brown.
entries.CrabPot_Description: Place it in the water, load it with bait, and check the next day to see if you've caught anything. Works in streams, lakes, and the ocean.
entries.Crab_Description: A marine crustacean with two powerful pincers.
entries.CrabshellRing_Description: The top of the ring is made from enchanted crab shell.
entries.Cranberries_Description: These tart red berries are a traditional winter food.
entries.CranberryCandy_Description: It's sweet enough to mask the bitter fruit.
entries.CranberrySeeds_Description: Plant these in the fall. Takes 7 days to mature, and continues to produce after first harvest.
entries.Crayfish_Description: A small freshwater relative of the lobster.
entries.Crimsonfish_Description: Lives deep in the ocean but likes to lay its eggs in the warm summer water.
entries.Crocus_Description: A flower that can bloom in the winter.
entries.CrystalFloor_Description: Place on the ground to create paths or to spruce up your floors.
entries.CrystalFruit_Description: A delicate fruit that pops up from the snow.
entries.CrystalPath_Description: Place on the ground to create paths or to spruce up your floors.
entries.CuriosityLure_Description: Increases your chance to catch rare fish.
entries.Daffodil_Description: A traditional spring flower that makes a nice gift.
entries.Dandelion_Description: Not the prettiest flower, but the leaves make a good salad.
entries.DarkTalismanDescription: You've found the {0}! It's covered in bug slime...
entries.DecorativePot_Description: A replica of an ancient pot.
entries.DeluxeBait_Description: Causes fish to bite even faster and increases size of the "fishing bar".
entries.DeluxeFertilizer_Description: Greatly improves soil quality, increasing your chance to grow quality crops. Mix into tilled soil.
entries.DeluxeRetainingSoil_Description: This soil has a 100% chance of staying watered overnight. Mix into tilled soil.
entries.DeluxeSpeedGro_Description: Stimulates leaf production. Guaranteed to increase growth rate by at least 25%. Mix into tilled soil.
entries.DinosaurEgg_Description: A giant dino egg... The entire shell is still intact!
entries.DinosaurMayonnaise_Description: It's thick and creamy, with a vivid green hue. It smells like grass and leather.
entries.DishOTheSea_Description: This'll keep you warm in the cold sea air.
entries.Dolomite_Description: It can occur in coral reefs, often near an underwater volcano.
entries.Dorado_Description: A fierce carnivore with brilliant orange scales.
entries.DragonTooth_Description: These are rumored to be the teeth of ancient serpents. The enamel is made of pure iridium!
entries.DressedSpinner_Description: The metal tab and colorful streamers create an enticing spectacle for fish. Increases the bite-rate when fishing.
entries.DriedStarfish_Description: A starfish from the primordial ocean. It's an unusually pristine specimen!
entries.Driftwood_Description: A piece of wood from the sea.
entries.DrumBlock_Description: Plays a drum sound when you walk past.
entries.DwarfGadget_Description: It's a piece of the advanced technology once known to the dwarves. It's still glowing and humming, but you're unable to understand how it works.
entries.DwarfScrollIII_Description: A yellowed scroll of parchment filled with dwarven script. This one's tied with a blue rope.
entries.DwarfScrollII_Description: A yellowed scroll of parchment filled with dwarven script. This one's tied with a green ribbon.
entries.DwarfScrollIV_Description: A yellowed scroll of parchment filled with dwarven script. This one's tied with a golden chain.
entries.DwarfScrollI_Description: A yellowed scroll of parchment filled with dwarven script. This one's tied with a red bow.
entries.DwarvishHelm_Description: It's one of the helmets commonly worn by dwarves. The thick metal plating protects them from falling debris and stalactites.
entries.EarthCrystal_Description: A resinous substance found near the surface.
entries.Ectoplasm_Description: A thick, slimy goop that the Wizard wants for some reason.
entries.EggplantSeeds_Description: Plant these in the fall. Takes 5 days to mature, and continues to produce after first harvest.
entries.Eggplant_Description: A rich and wholesome relative of the tomato. Delicious fried or stewed.
entries.ElvishJewelry_Description: Dirty but still beautiful. On the side is a flowing script thought by some to be the ancient language of the elves. No Elvish bones have ever been found.
entries.Emerald_Description: A precious stone with a brilliant green color.
entries.Enricher_Description: Place on a sprinkler and load with fertilizer to automatically apply it when planting seeds nearby.
entries.Esperite_Description: The crystals glow bright green when stimulated.
entries.FairyDust_Description: Sprinkle on kegs, furnaces, and other refining equipment to instantly receive their product.
entries.FairyRose_Description: An old folk legend suggests that the sweet smell of this flower attracts fairies.
entries.FairySeeds_Description: Plant in fall. Takes 12 days to produce a mysterious flower. Assorted Colors.
entries.FairyStone_Description: An old miner's song suggests these are made from the bones of ancient fairies.
entries.FallSeeds_Description: An assortment of wild fall seeds.
entries.FarAwayStone_Description: A stone of unknown origins. Looks like it could be placed into something.
entries.FiberSeeds_Description: Plant these in any season. Does not require watering. Harvest with the scythe. Takes 7 days to grow.
entries.FiddleheadFern_Description: The young shoots are an edible specialty.
entries.FiddleheadRisotto_Description: A creamy rice dish served with sauteed fern heads. It's a little bland.
entries.FieldSnack_Description: A quick snack to fuel the hungry forager.
entries.FireOpal_Description: A rare variety of opal, named for its red spots.
entries.FireQuartz_Description: A glowing red crystal commonly found near hot lava.
entries.FireworksGreen_Description: An old tradition for celebrations and festivities. Handle with care!
entries.FireworksPurple_Description: An old tradition for celebrations and festivities. Handle with care!
entries.FireworksRed_Description: An old tradition for celebrations and festivities. Handle with care!
entries.FishStew_Description: It smells a lot like the sea. Tastes better, though.
entries.Flounder_Description: It lives on the bottom, so both eyes are on top of its head.
entries.Fluorapatite_Description: Small amounts are found in human teeth.
entries.FluteBlock_Description: Plays a flute sound when you walk past.
entries.FossilStone_Description: Break apart to obtain fossils and bones.
entries.FossilizedLeg_Description: A thick and sturdy leg bone.
entries.FossilizedRibs_Description: Long ago, these ribs protected the body of a large animal.
entries.FossilizedTail_Description: This tail has a club-like feature at the tip.
entries.FrozenGeodeStone_Description: Break apart to obtain frozen geodes.
entries.FrozenGeode_Description: A blacksmith can break this open for you.
entries.FrozenTear_Description: A crystal fabled to be the frozen tears of a yeti.
entries.FruitSalad_Description: A delicious combination of summer fruits.
entries.FurnitureCatalogueDescription: Provides unlimited access to almost every furniture item... from the convenience of your home!
entries.GalaxySoul_Description: Forge 3 of these into a Galaxy weapon to unleash its final form.
entries.GarlicSeeds_Description: Plant these in the spring. Takes 4 days to mature.
entries.Garlic_Description: Adds a wonderful zestiness to dishes. High quality garlic can be pretty spicy.
entries.Gate_Description: Allows you to pass through a fence.
entries.GemStone_Description: Break apart to obtain stone, ores, or geodes.
entries.Geode_Description: A blacksmith can break this open for you.
entries.GhostCrystal_Description: There is an aura of coldness around this crystal.
entries.Ghostfish_Description: A pale, blind fish found in underground lakes.
entries.GingerAle_Description: A zesty soda known for its soothing effect on the stomach.
entries.Ginger_Description: This sharp, spicy root is said to increase vitality.
entries.GlacierfishJr_Description: The original Glacierfish had a son...
entries.Glacierfish_Description: Builds a nest on the underside of glaciers.
entries.GlassShards_Description: A mixture of glass shards smoothed by centuries of ocean surf. These could have belonged to an ancient mosaic or necklace.
entries.GlazedYams_Description: Sweet and satisfying... The sugar gives it a hint of caramel.
entries.GlowstoneRing_Description: Emits a constant light, and also increases your radius for collecting items.
entries.GoatCheese_Description: Soft cheese made from goat's milk.
entries.Goby_Description: Some types of Gobies can climb up waterfalls.
entries.GoldOre_Description: A precious ore that can be smelted into bars.
entries.GoldStone_Description: Break apart to obtain gold ore.
entries.GoldenAnimalCracker_Description: Give this to a farm animal to permanently double its produce yield. Doesn't work on pigs.
entries.GoldenCoconut_Description: This is one tough nut to crack, but a professional might be able to break it open.
entries.GoldenEgg_Description: A very rare and special egg with a solid gold shell.
entries.GoldenMask_Description: A creepy golden mask probably used in an ancient magic ritual. A socket in the forehead contains a large purple gemstone.
entries.GoldenPumpkin_Description: It's valuable but has no other purpose.
entries.GoldenRelic_Description: It's a golden slab with hieroglyphs and pictures emblazoned onto the front.
entries.GoldenWalnut_Description: To the parrots of Ginger Island, this nut is the finest delicacy.
entries.GourmetTomatoSalt_Description: A rare, delicious and savory salt.
entries.Granite_Description: A speckled Mineral that is commonly used in construction.
entries.GrapeStarter_Description: Plant these in the fall. Takes 10 days to grow, but keeps producing after that. Grows on a trellis.
entries.GrassBook_Description: You will now run a lot faster through grass and crops.
entries.GrassStarter_Description: Place this on your farm to start a new patch of grass.
entries.GravelPath_Description: Place on the ground to create paths or to spruce up your floors.
entries.GreenBean_Description: A juicy little bean with a cool, crisp snap.
entries.GreenRainWeeds_Description: Might contain fibers or mixed seeds.
entries.GreenSlimeEgg_Description: Can be hatched in a slime incubator.
entries.GreenTea_Description: A pleasant, energizing beverage made from lightly processed tea leaves.
entries.Halibut_Description: A flat fish that lives on the ocean floor.
entries.HardwoodFence_Description: The most durable type of fence.
entries.Hardwood_Description: A special kind of wood with superior strength and beauty.
entries.Hay_Description: Dried grass used as animal food.
entries.Hedge_Description: A shaped bush that acts like a fence.
entries.Helvite_Description: It grows in a triangular column.
entries.Hematite_Description: An iron-based Mineral with interesting magnetic properties.
entries.Holly_Description: The leaves and bright red berries make a popular winter decoration.
entries.Honey_Description: It's a sweet syrup produced by bees.
entries.HopsStarter_Description: Plant these in the summer. Takes 11 days to grow, but keeps producing after that. Grows on a trellis.
entries.Hops_Description: A bitter, tangy flower used to flavor beer.
entries.HorseFlute_Description: Playing this flute will summon your horse. Only works outdoors.
entries.HotJavaRing_Description: Greatly increases your chance to find coffee drinks when slaying monsters.
entries.HotPepper_Description: Fiery hot with a hint of sweetness.
entries.HyperSpeedGro_Description: Greatly stimulates leaf production. Guaranteed to increase growth rate by at least 33%. Mix into tilled soil.
entries.IceCream_Description: It's hard to find someone who doesn't like this.
entries.IcePip_Description: A rare fish that thrives in extremely cold conditions.
entries.ImmunityBand_Description: The top of the ring is made from enchanted purple wool.
entries.IridiumBand_Description: Glows, attracts items, and increases attack damage by 10%.
entries.IridiumOre_Description: An exotic ore with many curious properties. Can be smelted into bars.
entries.IridiumSprinkler_Description: Waters the 24 adjacent tiles every morning.
entries.IridiumStone_Description: Break apart to obtain iridium ore.
entries.IronFence_Description: Lasts longer than a stone fence.
entries.IronOre_Description: A fairly common ore that can be smelted into bars.
entries.IronStone_Description: Break apart to obtain iron ore.
entries.Jagoite_Description: A high volume of tiny crystals makes it very glittery.
entries.Jamborite_Description: The crystals are so tightly packed it almost looks fuzzy.
entries.Jasper_Description: When polished, this stone becomes attractively luminous. Prized by ancient peoples for thousands of years.
entries.JazzSeeds_Description: Plant in spring. Takes 7 days to produce a blue puffball flower.
entries.JojaCola_Description: The flagship product of Joja corporation.
entries.JournalScrap_Description: A damp tattered page torn from an old journal...
entries.JukeboxRing_Description: Plays a random assortment of music you've heard.
entries.KaleSeeds_Description: Plant these in the spring. Takes 6 days to mature. Harvest with the scythe.
entries.Kale_Description: The waxy leaves are great in soups and stir fries.
entries.Kyanite_Description: The geometric faces are as smooth as glass.
entries.LGoatMilk_Description: A gallon of creamy goat's milk.
entries.LargeBrownEgg_Description: It's an uncommonly large brown egg!
entries.LargeMilk_Description: A large jug of cow's milk.
entries.LargeWhiteEgg_Description: It's an uncommonly large white egg!
entries.LargemouthBass_Description: A popular fish that lives in lakes.
entries.LavaEel_Description: It can somehow survive in pools of red-hot lava.
entries.LeadBobber_Description: Adds weight to your "fishing bar", preventing it from bouncing along the bottom.
entries.Leek_Description: A tasty relative of the onion.
entries.LegendII_Description: The successor to the original Legend.
entries.Legend_Description: The king of all fish! They said he'd never be caught.
entries.LemonStone_Description: Some claim the powdered crystal is a dwarvish delicacy.
entries.Limestone_Description: A very common type of stone. It's not worth very much.
entries.Lingcod_Description: A fearsome predator that will eat almost anything it can cram into its mouth.
entries.Lionfish_Description: An aggressive, predatory fish with venomous spines.
entries.LobsterBisque_Description: This delicate soup is a secret family recipe of Willy's.
entries.Lobster_Description: A large ocean-dwelling crustacean with a strong tail.
entries.LostAxe_Description: Robin's been looking everywhere for it.
entries.LostBook_Description: Writings from a wide variety of time periods.
entries.LuckyPurpleShorts_Description: Better not inspect these too closely.
entries.LuckyRing_Description: The lunar emblem is said to bring good luck to whoever wears it.
entries.Lumber_Description: A versatile resource used for building and fuel.
entries.Lunarite_Description: The cratered white orbs form a tight cluster.
entries.MagicBait_Description: Allows you to catch fish from any season, time, or weather, from whichever type of water you cast into.
entries.MagicInkDescription: You've found the Wizard's lost {0}! Better return it to him.
entries.MagicRockCandy_Description: A rare and powerful candy infused with the essence of the prismatic shard.
entries.MagmaCap_Description: A very rare mushroom that lives next to pools of lava.
entries.MagmaGeodeStone_Description: Break apart to obtain magma geodes.
entries.MagmaGeode_Description: A blacksmith can break this open for you.
entries.MagnetRing_Description: Increases your radius for collecting items.
entries.Magnet_Description: Increases the chance of finding treasures when fishing. However, fish aren't crazy about the taste.
entries.MagnifyingGlassDescription: You received the {0}! You now have the ability to find 'Secret Notes'. These notes reveal rare and useful information, and can be reviewed in your collections tab.
entries.MahoganySeed_Description: This can be planted to grow a mahogany tree.
entries.MakiRoll_Description: Fish and rice wrapped in seaweed.
entries.Malachite_Description: A popular ornamental stone, used in sculpture and to make green paint.
entries.MangoSapling_Description: Takes 28 days to produce a mature Mango tree. Bears fruit in the summer, or all year round when planted on Ginger Island.
entries.MangoStickyRice_Description: Sweet mango and coconut transforms this rice into something very special.
entries.Mango_Description: A big, sweet tropical fruit with a unique flavor.
entries.MapleBar_Description: It's a sweet doughnut topped with a rich maple glaze.
entries.MapleSeed_Description: This can be planted to grow a maple tree.
entries.MapleSyrup_Description: A sweet syrup with a unique flavor.
entries.Marble_Description: A very popular material for sculptures and construction.
entries.Mead_Description: A fermented beverage made from honey. Drink in moderation.
entries.MegaBomb_Description: Generates a powerful explosion. Use with extreme caution.
entries.MelonSeeds_Description: Plant these in the summer. Takes 12 days to mature.
entries.MermaidsPendant_Description: Give this to the person you want to marry.
entries.MidnightCarp_Description: This shy fish only feels comfortable at night.
entries.MidnightSquid_Description: A strange and mysterious denizen of the ocean's twilight depths.
entries.MinersTreat_Description: This should keep your energy up.
entries.MixedFlowerSeeds_Description: An assortment of flower seeds. Plant them and see what grows!
entries.MixedSeeds_Description: There's a little bit of everything here. Plant them and see what grows!
entries.MonsterMusk_Description: Spray this on to draw more monsters out of hiding.
entries.Morel_Description: Sought after for its unique nutty flavor.
entries.MossSoup_Description: It's thick and slimy, but edible.
entries.Moss_Description: A special type of plant that grows in shady areas.
entries.MossySeed_Description: This can be planted to grow rare wild trees.
entries.MovieTicket_Description: Admits one to the movie theater. Giving this to a friend invites them to the movies with you.
entries.MsAngler_Description: Uses a bioluminescent dangler to attract prey.
entries.Mudstone_Description: A fine-grained rock made from ancient clay or mud.
entries.MummifiedBat_Description: The delicate wings have been perfectly preserved.
entries.MummifiedFrog_Description: This ancient frog may have lived in the jungle canopy.
entries.MuscleRemedy_Description: When you've pushed your body too hard, drink this to remove 'Exhaustion'.
entries.MushroomTreeSeed_Description: Place this on your farm to plant a mushroom tree.
entries.Mussel_Description: A common bivalve that often lives in clusters.
entries.MutantCarp_Description: The strange waters of the sewer turned this carp into a monstrosity.
entries.MysteryBox_Description: A blacksmith can open this for you. Who knows what might be inside?
entries.MysticStone_Description: Break apart to obtain stone, ores, or geodes.
entries.MysticSyrup_Description: A very rare syrup that is said to have magic properties.
entries.MysticTreeSeed_Description: This can be planted to grow a special tree.
entries.NapalmRing_Description: When you defeat an enemy, they explode.
entries.NautilusFossil_Description: This must've washed up ages ago from an ancient coral reef.
entries.Nekoite_Description: The delicate shards form a tiny pink meadow.
entries.Neptunite_Description: A jet-black crystal that is unusually reflective.
entries.OakResin_Description: A sticky, fragrant substance derived from oak sap.
entries.Obsidian_Description: A volcanic glass that forms when lava cools rapidly.
entries.OceanStone_Description: An old legend claims these stones are the mosaics of ancient mermaids.
entries.OilofGarlic_Description: Drink this and weaker monsters will avoid you.
entries.OmniGeodeStone_Description: Break apart to obtain omni geodes.
entries.OmniGeode_Description: A blacksmith can break this open for you. These geodes contain a wide variety of minerals.
entries.Opal_Description: Its internal structure causes it to reflect a rainbow of light.
entries.OrangeSapling_Description: Takes 28 days to produce a mature Orange tree. Bears fruit in the summer. Only grows if the 8 surrounding "tiles" are empty.
entries.Orange_Description: Juicy, tangy, and bursting with sweet summer aroma.
entries.OrnamentalFan_Description: This exquisite fan most likely belonged to a noblewoman. Historians believe that the valley was a popular sixth-era vacation spot for the wealthy.
entries.OrnateNecklace_Description: A fancy necklace found in the water outside of the bath house. It's still wet...
entries.Orpiment_Description: Despite its high toxicity, this Mineral is widely used in manufacturing and folk medicine.
entries.OstrichEgg_Description: It may be the world's largest egg.
entries.Oyster_Description: Constantly filters water to find food. In the process, it removes dangerous toxins from the environment.
entries.PaleBroth_Description: A delicate broth with a hint of sulfur.
entries.PalmFossil_Description: Palm Fossils are relatively common, but this happens to be a particularly well-preserved specimen.
entries.Pancakes_Description: A double stack of fluffy, soft pancakes.
entries.ParsnipSeedPackage_SomeoneElse: This package belongs to someone else.
entries.ParsnipSeeds_Description: Plant these in the spring. Takes 4 days to mature.
entries.Parsnip_Description: A spring tuber closely related to the carrot. It has an earthy taste and is full of nutrients.
entries.PeachSapling_Description: Takes 28 days to produce a mature Peach tree. Bears fruit in the summer. Only grows if the 8 surrounding "tiles" are empty.
entries.Peach_Description: It's almost fuzzy to the touch.
entries.Pearl_Description: A rare treasure from the sea.
entries.PepperPoppers_Description: Spicy breaded peppers filled with cheese.
entries.PepperSeeds_Description: Plant these in the summer. Takes 5 days to mature, and continues to produce after first harvest.
entries.Perch_Description: A freshwater fish of the winter.
entries.Periwinkle_Description: A tiny freshwater snail that lives in a blue shell.
entries.PetLicense_Description: Invite a new pet into your home. If you don't have enough outdoor pet bowls for your pets, they will become upset.
entries.PetrifiedSlime_Description: This little guy may be 100,000 years old.
entries.PhoenixRing_Description: Once a day, regain some health after being knocked out in combat.
entries.Pickles_Description: A jar of your home-made pickles.
entries.PierresMissingStocklist_Description: Pierre might be interested in this.
entries.Pike_Description: A freshwater fish that's difficult to catch.
entries.PineCone_Description: This can be planted to grow a pine tree.
entries.PineTar_Description: A pungent substance derived from pine sap.
entries.PineappleSeeds_Description: Plant these in warm weather. Takes 14 days to mature, and keeps producing fruit after that.
entries.Pineapple_Description: A sweet and tangy tropical treat.
entries.PinkCake_Description: There's little heart candies on top.
entries.Pizza_Description: It's popular for all the right reasons.
entries.Poi_Description: A traditional food with a delicate, sweet flavor when eaten fresh.
entries.PomegranateSapling_Description: Takes 28 days to produce a mature Pomegranate tree. Bears fruit in the fall. Only grows if the 8 surrounding "tiles" are empty.
entries.Pomegranate_Description: Within the fruit are clusters of juicy seeds.
entries.PoppySeeds_Description: Plant in summer. Produces a bright red flower in 7 days.
entries.Poppy_Description: In addition to its colorful flower, the Poppy has culinary and medicinal uses.
entries.PotatoSeeds_Description: Plant these in the spring. Takes 6 days to mature, and has a chance of yielding multiple potatoes at harvest.
entries.PowdermelonSeeds_Description: This special melon grows in the winter. Takes 7 days to grow.
entries.Powdermelon_Description: Named for the powdery coating that forms on the surface, this melon is crisp and sweet, with a delicate flavor.
entries.PrehistoricHandaxe_Description: One of the earliest tools employed by humans. This "crude" tool was created by striking one rock with another to form a sharp edge.
entries.PrehistoricRib_Description: Little gouge marks on the side suggest that this rib was someone's dinner.
entries.PrehistoricScapula_Description: Commonly known as a "shoulder blade"... It's unclear what species it belonged to.
entries.PrehistoricSkull_Description: This is definitely a mammalian skull.
entries.PrehistoricTibia_Description: A thick and sturdy leg bone.
entries.PrehistoricTool_Description: Some kind of gnarly old digging tool.
entries.PrehistoricVertebra_Description: A segment of some prehistoric creature's spine.
entries.PressureNozzle_Description: Place on a sprinkler to increase its watering range.
entries.PrismaticJelly_Description: Harvested from the rare and elusive prismatic slime.
entries.PrismaticShard_Description: A very rare and powerful substance with unknown origins.
entries.PrizeTicket_Description: Bring this to the prize machine in Lewis' house for a special reward.
entries.ProtectionRing_Description: Stay invincible for a little while longer after taking damage.
entries.PumpkinPie_Description: Silky pumpkin cream in a flaky crust.
entries.PumpkinSeeds_Description: Plant these in the fall. Takes 13 days to mature.
entries.Pumpkin_Description: A fall favorite, grown for its crunchy seeds and delicately flavored flesh. As a bonus, the hollow shell can be carved into a festive decoration.
entries.PurpleBook_Description: Read this to gain some experience in all skills.
entries.PurpleMushroom_Description: A rare mushroom found deep in caves.
entries.PurpleSlimeEgg_Description: Can be hatched in a slime incubator.
entries.QiBean_Description: Plant these in any season. Water every day to produce a Qi Fruit. Takes 4 days to mature.
entries.QiFruit_Description: Mr. Qi has challenged you to ship 500 of these strange melons.
entries.QiGem_Description: A special currency honored by Mr. Qi.
entries.QiSeasoning_Description: Just a dash will elevate any dish to extraordinary heights. Automatically applied when cooking.
entries.QualityBobber_Description: Boosts the quality of fish that you catch.
entries.QualityFertilizer_Description: Improves soil quality, increasing your chance to grow quality crops. Mix into tilled soil.
entries.QualityRetainingSoil_Description: This soil has a good chance of staying watered overnight. Mix into tilled soil.
entries.QualitySprinkler_Description: Waters the 8 adjacent tiles every morning.
entries.Quartz_Description: A clear crystal commonly found in caves and mines.
entries.RadioactiveBar_Description: Known by the Zuzu City Safety Commission to cause irreversible bodily harm.
entries.RadioactiveCarp_Description: A carp that spent one too many years in toxic sludge.
entries.RadioactiveOre_Description: It's glowing with dangerous energy... Can be smelted into bars.
entries.RadishSeeds_Description: Plant these in the summer. Takes 6 days to mature.
entries.Radish_Description: A crisp and refreshing root vegetable with hints of pepper when eaten raw.
entries.RainTotem_Description: Activate to greatly increase the chance for rain tomorrow. Consumed on use.
entries.RainbowTrout_Description: A freshwater trout with colorful markings.
entries.Raisins_Description: It's said to be the Junimos' favorite food.
entries.RareDisc_Description: A heavy black disc studded with peculiar red stones. When you hold it, you're overwhelmed with a feeling of dread.
entries.RareSeed_Description: Sow in fall. Takes all season to grow.
entries.RedCabbageSeeds_Description: Plant these in the summer. Takes 9 days to mature.
entries.RedCabbage_Description: Often used in salads and coleslaws. The color can range from purple to blue to green-yellow depending on soil conditions.
entries.RedMullet_Description: Long ago these were kept as pets.
entries.RedMushroom_Description: A spotted mushroom sometimes found in caves.
entries.RedSlimeEgg_Description: Can be hatched in a slime incubator.
entries.RedSnapper_Description: A popular fish with a nice red color.
entries.RefinedQuartz_Description: A more pure form of quartz.
entries.RhubarbSeeds_Description: Plant these in the spring. Takes 13 days to mature.
entries.Rhubarb_Description: The stalks are extremely tart, but make a great dessert when sweetened.
entries.RicePudding_Description: It's creamy, sweet, and fun to eat.
entries.RiceShoot_Description: Plant these in the spring. Takes 8 days to mature. Grows faster if planted near a body of water. Harvest with the scythe.
entries.Rice_Description: A basic grain often served under vegetables.
entries.RingofYoba_Description: Occasionally shields the wearer from damage.
entries.RiverJelly_Description: A rare jelly found in freshwater.
entries.RoastedHazelnuts_Description: The roasting process creates a rich forest flavor.
entries.Roe_Description: Fresh fish eggs. These can be aged in a preserves jar to bring out more flavor.
entries.RootsPlatter_Description: This'll get you digging for more.
entries.RottenPlant_Description: Decomposing organic material. It's slimy and unpleasant.
entries.Ruby_Description: A precious stone that is sought after for its rich color and beautiful luster.
entries.RusticPlankFloor_Description: Place on the ground to create paths or to decorate your floors.
entries.RustyCog_Description: A well preserved cog that must have been part of some ancient machine. This could be dwarven technology.
entries.RustySpoon_Description: A plain old spoon, probably ten years old. Not very interesting.
entries.RustySpur_Description: An old spur that was once attached to a cowboy's boot. People must have been raising animals in this area for many generations.
entries.SalmonDinner_Description: The lemon spritz makes it special.
entries.Salmon_Description: Swims upstream to lay its eggs.
entries.Salmonberry_Description: A spring-time berry with the flavor of the forest.
entries.Sandfish_Description: It tries to hide using camouflage.
entries.Sandstone_Description: A common type of stone with red and brown striations.
entries.Sashimi_Description: Raw fish sliced into thin pieces.
entries.SavageRing_Description: Gain a short speed boost whenever you slay a monster.
entries.ScorpionCarp_Description: It's like a regular carp but with a sharp stinger.
entries.SeaCucumber_Description: A slippery, slimy creature found on the ocean floor.
entries.SeaJelly_Description: A rare jelly found in the ocean.
entries.SeaUrchin_Description: A slow-moving, spiny creature that some consider a delicacy.
entries.SeafoamPudding_Description: This briny pudding will really get you into the maritime mindset!
entries.Seaweed_Description: It can be used in cooking.
entries.SecretNote_Description: It's old and crumpled, but if you look closely you can make out the details...
entries.Shad_Description: Lives in a school at sea, but returns to the rivers to spawn.
entries.ShrimpCocktail_Description: A sumptuous appetizer made with freshly-caught shrimp.
entries.Shrimp_Description: A scavenger that feeds off the ocean floor. Widely prized for its meat.
entries.SkeletalHand_Description: It's a wonder all these ancient little pieces lasted so long.
entries.SkeletalTail_Description: It's pretty short for a tail.
entries.SkillBook0_Description: Read this to gain some farming experience.
entries.SkillBook1_Description: Read this to gain some fishing experience.
entries.SkillBook2_Description: Read this to gain some foraging experience.
entries.SkillBook3_Description: Read this to gain some mining experience.
entries.SkillBook4_Description: Read this to gain some combat experience.
entries.Slate_Description: It's extremely resistant to water, making it a good roofing material.
entries.SlimeCrate_Description: Use this to transport a domesticated slime to another location.
entries.Slime_Description: A shimmering, gelatinous glob with no smell.
entries.Slimejack_Description: He's coated in a very thick layer of slime. He keeps slipping out of your hands!
entries.SmallMagnetRing_Description: Slightly increases your radius for collecting items.
entries.SmallmouthBass_Description: A freshwater fish that is very sensitive to pollution.
entries.SmokedFish_CollectionsTabDescription: A whole fish, smoked to perfection.
entries.Snail_Description: A wide-ranging mollusc that lives in a spiral shell.
entries.SnakeSkull_Description: A preserved skull that once belonged to a snake.
entries.SnakeVertebrae_Description: It appears this serpent may have been extremely flexible.
entries.SnowYam_Description: This little yam was hiding beneath the snow.
entries.SnowyStone_Description: Break apart to obtain stone, ores, or geodes.
entries.Soapstone_Description: Because of its relatively soft consistency, this stone is very popular for carving.
entries.SolarEssence_Description: The glowing face is warm to the touch.
entries.SonarBobber_Description: Shows what fish is on the line before it's caught.
entries.SonofCrimsonfish_Description: He hatched in the warm summer water, and followed in the footsteps of his father.
entries.SoulSapperRing_Description: Gain a little bit of energy every time you slay a monster.
entries.SpangleSeeds_Description: Plant in summer. Takes 8 days to produce a vibrant tropical flower. Assorted colors.
entries.SpecialCharmDescription: You received the {0}! You feel an aura of good fortune surrounding you (luck is permanently increased)!
entries.SpeedGro_Description: Stimulates leaf production. Guaranteed to increase growth rate by at least 10%. Mix into tilled soil.
entries.SpiceBerry_Description: It fills the air with a pungent aroma.
entries.Spinner_Description: The shape makes it spin around in the water. Slightly increases the bite-rate when fishing.
entries.SpiritTorch_Description: It's unclear where the blue color comes from...
entries.SpookFish_Description: The huge eyes can detect the faint silhouettes of prey.
entries.SpringOnion_Description: These grow wild during the spring.
entries.SpringSeeds_Description: An assortment of wild spring seeds.
entries.Sprinkler_Description: Waters the 4 adjacent tiles every morning.
entries.SquidInk_Description: Squid use this ink to confuse would-be predators.
entries.Squid_Description: A deep sea creature that can grow to enormous size.
entries.StarShards_Description: No one knows how these form. Some scientists claim that the microscopic structure displays unnatural regularity.
entries.StardewValleyRose_Description: A rose that reminds you of the valley. It smells heavenly.
entries.StardropTea_Description: A very special gift that would delight anyone.
entries.Stardrop_Description: A mysterious fruit that empowers those who eat it. The flavor is like a dream... a powerful personal experience, yet difficult to describe to others.
entries.StarfruitSeeds_Description: Plant these in the summer. Takes 13 days to mature.
entries.Starfruit_Description: An extremely juicy fruit that grows in hot, humid weather. Slightly sweet with a sour undertone.
entries.SteppingStonePath_Description: Place on the ground to create paths or to spruce up your floors.
entries.Stingray_Description: Despite having a toxic stinger, these fish are shy and prefer to avoid humans.
entries.StirFry_Description: Julienned vegetables on a bed of rice.
entries.StoneFence_Description: Lasts longer than a wood fence.
entries.StoneFloor_Description: Place on the ground to create paths or to spruce up your floors.
entries.StoneWalkwayFloor_Description: Place on the ground to create paths or to decorate your floors.
entries.Stone_Description: A common material with many uses in crafting and building.
entries.Stone_NodeWithCoal_Description: Break apart to obtain stone with a chance of coal.
entries.Stone_Node_Description: Break apart to obtain stone, ores, or geodes.
entries.Stonefish_Description: A bizarre fish that's shaped like a brick.
entries.StrawFloor_Description: Place on the ground to create paths or to spruce up your floors.
entries.StrawberrySeeds_Description: Plant these in spring. Takes 8 days to mature, and keeps producing strawberries after that.
entries.Strawberry_Description: A sweet, juicy favorite with an appealing red color.
entries.Stuffing_Description: Ahh... the smell of warm bread and sage.
entries.SturdyRing_Description: Cuts the duration of negative status effects in half.
entries.Sturgeon_Description: An ancient bottom-feeder with a dwindling population. Females can live up to 150 years.
entries.Sugar_Description: Adds sweetness to pastries and candies. Too much can be unhealthy.
entries.SummerSeeds_Description: An assortment of wild summer seeds.
entries.SummerSpangle_Description: A tropical bloom that thrives in the humid summer air. Has a sweet, tangy aroma.
entries.SummerSquashSeeds_Description: Plant in the summer. Takes 6 days to grow, and continues to produce after first harvest.
entries.SummerSquash_Description: A curved yellow squash that is harvested while immature, and still tender.
entries.SunflowerSeeds_Description: Plant in summer or fall. Takes 8 days to produce a large sunflower. Yields more seeds at harvest.
entries.Sunflower_Description: A common misconception is that the flower turns so it's always facing the sun.
entries.SuperCucumber_Description: A rare, purple variety of sea cucumber.
entries.SurvivalBurger_Description: A convenient snack for the explorer.
entries.SweetGemBerry_Description: It's by far the sweetest thing you've ever smelled.
entries.TaroRoot_Description: This starchy root is one of the most ancient crops.
entries.TaroTuber_Description: Plant these in warm weather. Takes 10 days to mature. Grows faster if planted near a body of water.
entries.TeaLeaves_Description: The young leaves of the tea plant. Can be brewed into the popular, energizing beverage.
entries.TeaSapling_Description: Takes 20 days to mature. Produces tea leaves during the final week of each season, except winter. No watering necessary!
entries.TentKit_Description: Use this to deploy a one-time-use tent for sleeping. Can only be used outdoors.
entries.ThornsRing_Description: When enemies damage you, they will take damage themselves.
entries.ThunderEgg_Description: According to legend, angry thunder spirits would throw these stones at one another.
entries.TigerSlimeEgg_Description: Can be hatched in a slime incubator. Use with extreme caution!
entries.TigerTrout_Description: A rare hybrid trout that cannot bear offspring of its own.
entries.Tigerseye_Description: A stripe of shimmering gold gives this gem a warm luster.
entries.Tilapia_Description: A primarily vegetarian fish that prefers warm water.
entries.TomatoSeeds_Description: Plant these in the summer. Takes 11 days to mature, and continues to produce after first harvest.
entries.Tomato_Description: Rich and slightly tangy, the Tomato has a wide variety of culinary uses.
entries.TopazRing_Description: You feel a little bit safer wearing this.
entries.Topaz_Description: Fairly common but still prized for its beauty.
entries.Torch_Description: Provides a modest amount of light.
entries.Tortilla_Description: Can be used as a vessel for food or eaten by itself.
entries.TrapBobber_Description: Causes fish to escape slower when you aren't reeling them in.
entries.TreasureChest_Description: Wow, it's loaded with treasure! This is sure to fetch a good price.
entries.TreasureHunter_Description: Fish don't escape while collecting treasures. Also slightly increases the chance to find treasures.
entries.TreasureTotem_Description: Use on diggable terrain to summon a ring of treasure spots.
entries.TreeFertilizer_Description: Sprinkle on a wild tree to ensure rapid growth, even in winter. Doesn't work on fruit trees.
entries.Trilobite_Description: A long extinct relative of the crab.
entries.TrimmedLuckyPurpleShorts_Description: Purple silk shorts trimmed in luxurious gold...
entries.TripleShotEspresso_Description: It's more potent than regular coffee!
entries.TropicalCurry_Description: An exotic, fragrant curry served in a pineapple bowl.
entries.TroutDerbyTag_Description: Turn this in to the Trout Derby booth for a reward.
entries.Truffle_Description: A gourmet type of mushroom with a unique taste.
entries.TulipBulb_Description: Plant in spring. Takes 6 days to produce a colorful flower. Assorted colors.
entries.Tulip_Description: The most popular spring flower. Has a very faint sweet smell.
entries.Tuna_Description: A large fish that lives in the ocean.
entries.Twig_Description: A broken branch. Chop with an axe to obtain wood.
entries.UnmilledRice_Description: Rice in its rawest form. Run this through a mill to increase the value.
entries.VampireRing_Description: Gain a little health every time you slay a monster.
entries.Vinegar_Description: An aged fermented liquid used in many cooking recipes.
entries.VoidEgg_Description: A jet-black egg with red flecks. It's warm to the touch.
entries.VoidGhostPendant_Description: It's symbolic to the shadow people. As a gift, it signifies the desire to move in together as friends.
entries.VoidMayonnaise_Description: A thick, black paste that smells like burnt hair.
entries.VoidSalmon_Description: A salmon, twisted by void energy. The fresh meat is jet black, but rapidly turns pink when exposed to air.
entries.VolcanoGoldNode_Description: Break apart to obtain gold ore.
entries.Walleye_Description: A freshwater fish caught at night.
entries.WarMemento_Description: It's a faded photograph of a soldier...
entries.WarpTotemBeach_Description: Warp directly to the beach. Consumed on use.
entries.WarpTotemDesert_Description: Warp directly to Calico Desert. Consumed on use.
entries.WarpTotemFarm_Description: Warp directly to your house. Consumed on use.
entries.WarpTotemIsland_Description: Warp directly to Ginger Island. Consumed on use.
entries.WarpTotemMountains_Description: Warp directly to the mountains. Consumed on use.
entries.WarpTotemQisArena_Description: Warp to Qi's Arena. Be prepared for a challenge!.
entries.WarriorRing_Description: Occasionally infuses the wearer with "warrior energy" after slaying a monster.
entries.WeatheredFloor_Description: Place on the ground to create paths or to spruce up your floors.
entries.WeddingRing_Description: An old Zuzu City tradition... It's used to ask for another farmer's hand in marriage.
entries.Weeds_DryBush_Description: A cluster of dry old bushes. Might contain fibers or mixed seeds.
entries.Weeds_FiberOrMixedSeeds_Description: Might contain fibers or mixed seeds.
entries.Weeds_FiberOrMixedSeeds_Ugly_Description: Ugly weeds. Might contain fibers or mixed seeds.
entries.Weeds_Fiber_Ugly_Description: Ugly weeds. Cut to obtain wild seeds.
entries.WheatFlour_Description: A common cooking ingredient made from crushed wheat seeds.
entries.WheatSeeds_Description: Plant these in the summer or fall. Takes 4 days to mature. Harvest with the scythe.
entries.Wheat_Description: One of the most widely cultivated grains. Makes a great flour for breads and cakes.
entries.WildBait_Description: A unique recipe from Linus that gives you a chance to catch two fish at once.
entries.WildHorseradish_Description: A spicy root found in the spring.
entries.WildPlum_Description: Tart and juicy with a pungent aroma.
entries.WiltedBouquet_Description: A gift that shows you want to stop dating someone.
entries.WinterSeeds_Description: An assortment of wild winter seeds.
entries.WoodFloor_Description: Place on the ground to create paths or to decorate your floors.
entries.WoodPath_Description: Place on the ground to create paths or to spruce up your floors.
entries.Wood_Description: A sturdy, yet flexible plant material with a wide variety of uses.
entries.Woodskip_Description: A very sensitive fish that can only live in pools deep in the forest.
entries.YamSeeds_Description: Plant these in the fall. Takes 10 days to mature.
entries.Yam_Description: A starchy tuber with a lot of culinary versatility.
